result.instructions: Tools for SmartDoctor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments does the clinic have tomorrow?"; "Is there a free cardiology slot on Friday morning?"; "Book a dermatology visit for a patient on the first free time next Tuesday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SmartDoctor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartdoctor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartdoctor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartdoctor_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smartdoctor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartdoctor_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List the clinic's appointments from a start date (default today), optionally for one patient or one status. Uses GET /integracao/agendas/listar.

patient_cpf.description: Only appointments of this patient (CPF, with or without mask).

tools.name: smartdoctor_get_appointment
tools.title: Get an appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by id: date, time, status, specialty, doctor, unit, price and patient. Uses GET /integracao/agendas/{id}.

tools.name: smartdoctor_check_appointment_conflict
tools.title: Check for a duplicate appointment
tools.description: Check whether the patient already has an appointment on that date for that specialty, to avoid a double booking. An empty list means no conflict. Uses GET /integracao/agendas/verificar.

patient_cpf.description: Patient CPF, with or without mask.

tools.name: smartdoctor_list_free_slots
tools.title: List free time slots
tools.description: List the free time slots per doctor for one specialty, before a time is offered to a patient. Read-only, sent as a POST. Uses POST /integracao/controle-agendas/horarios-disponiveis.

tools.name: smartdoctor_find_patient_by_cpf
tools.title: Find a patient by CPF
tools.description: Check whether a CPF is already a patient of the clinic, and get the contact details. The answer has encontrado (true or false); when false, the patient is not registered. Uses GET /integracao/pacientes/cpf.

tools.name: smartdoctor_list_prices
tools.title: List consultation prices
tools.description: List the clinic's active specialties and their prices (convenio PARTICULAR and others). Uses GET /integracao/consultas-valor.

tools.name: smartdoctor_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: Book a consultation for a patient. Without a time, the first free time of the day is used. For a new patient (CPF not yet registered), patient_name, patient_phone and patient_birth_date are all required. The specialty needs a PARTICULAR price and a schedule on that date. Uses POST /integracao/agendas.

time.description: Start time HH:mm. It must be free. Omit to take the first free time.

patient_cpf.description: Patient CPF, with or without mask.

patient_name.description: Full name. Required when the patient is new.

patient_phone.description: Mobile phone, e.g. 11999998888. Required when the patient is new.

patient_birth_date.description: Birth date, yyyy-mm-dd. Required when the patient is new.

doctor_id.description: Fix one doctor (id from smartdoctor_list_free_slots). Omit for any doctor.

note.description: Free note, e.g. how the booking was made.

tools.name: smartdoctor_reschedule_appointment
tools.title: Reschedule an appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new date and time. The new time must be free. Uses PUT /integracao/agendas with the appointment id.

tools.name: smartdoctor_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel an appointment
tools.description: Cancel an appointment by id (status becomes CANCELADO). The appointment is kept in the clinic's records. Uses PUT /integracao/agendas.
